rationale: AGENTS.md declares hierarchical_v2 and v3 VOID: both were trained before the 2026-09-04 sim boundary (control-every-agent + PDM lateral offsets), so they optimised a different simulator. AGENTS.md further states that settling whether a fault-agnostic collision band beats v4 needs v3 RETRAINED under the current sim, not re-scored -- so an archived v3 weight could not produce a valid number. Their already-scored artifacts (table_main_v3/, rescore_face_20260907/, table_main_20260830/) are KEPT; the v3 row of the reward table rests on those.
